candidate_policy: Union of verified ordinary shares with previous-session return >=5% in saved broad ranking table, plus every ordinary share in the previous-session-after-close to cutoff news digest. Partial universe, not exhaustive TSE; digest omissions and data access failures reported.

features.freshness: New event first eligible for today's cutoff: base points; continuation for next two sessions: base*0.5; older:0
features.dilution: -1 when new shares/warrants/convertible bonds explicitly disclosed
features.negative: -4 for forecast reduction, audit disclaimer, listing supervision; -1 for margin restriction
features.liquidity: No exclusion by small turnover; target rank and tradability are separate

scoring: material + momentum + market + dilution + negative. If multiple eligible events, maximum positive material base, all explicit penalties once each.
missing_policy: Missing momentum:0 points and explicit missing flag. Missing longer OHLCV, float, margin balance, 08:30 quotes:unused, not imputed. Unknown material:0. Absent event is absence in retrieved coverage, not proof no news.
evidence_policy: Each selected row must have archived original dated release or contemporaneous dated record whose content used is corroborated by dated release; price evidence is prior-session dated table, never current-day result. Reject post-cutoff and unverified revisions. Timestamp precision minutes uses conservative end-of-minute available_at; boundary 08:30 minute excluded without seconds proof.
limitations: Retrospective reconstruction, not historical live forecast
Some future snippets incidentally exposed before freeze; not blind
Partial candidate coverage; all-TSE performance claim prohibited
Heuristic derived qualitatively from June cases, not fitted statistical model
frozen_before: first July prediction sealing and intentional retrieval of July actual rankings
